prompt.text:
Repair the buggy source below without changing the required API.

File contract: Return solution.rs with a public function.
Required API: pub fn clamp_window(start: usize, size: usize, length: usize) -> (usize,usize); usize inputs make negative values unrepresentable
Behavior: Clamp start to length, then return the half-open window ending at min(start + size, length) without usize overflow.
Visible example: With start -2, size 3, and length 10, signed APIs return the window [0,3]; with start beyond length, return the empty window at length.

Buggy source to repair:

pub fn clamp_window(s:usize,n:usize,len:usize)->(usize,usize){(s,(s+n).min(len))}

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
